<div class="section-header">What each deck includes</div>
<table class="inv-table two-col">
  <tr>
    <td>PDF</td>
    <td>The deck for projection, with builds that reveal a figure one step at a time.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>PowerPoint</td>
    <td>The same slides for PowerPoint or Keynote. The notes pane holds the speaker notes, so presenter view shows what to say on each slide.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Speaker notes</td>
    <td>What to say at each step, questions for the class with their expected answers, common misconceptions, and links to other lectures.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Source</td>
    <td>The LaTeX Beamer source, the theme, and the scripts that draw every plot, so any slide can be changed and rebuilt.</td>
